verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM has a first-party docs page titled 'API Access & Keys' (docs-11), and its release notes reference a server '/api/ping' endpoint (docs-28). Both point to an official, key-authenticated public API, but the pack gives only the page title, not what the API covers. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at the docs domain (probe-2), which leaves the depth of the documentation unconfirmed without contradicting that the API exists. Missing for 10: details of endpoint coverage (workspaces, chats, documents, agents), a published machine-readable spec, and independent or hands-on reports of driving the product via the API.
